svg.text: Write with N=3 replicas, W=2 acks · read with R=2 (quorum: W + R > N)

g.text: Client sends a write to a coordinator node
Coordinator sends it to the N=3 nodes on the hash ring
W=2 acks arrive → write is successful
Client is told OK; the 3rd replica catches up later
Memtable full → flushed to an immutable SSTable on disk
Read asks replicas; with R=2, W+R>N so one is surely fresh
Newest version (by vector clock) is returned
